'''Quellon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] [[Starrunner (light freighter)|''Starrunner'']] that belonged to a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] scavengers, who looted [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] a few [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before [[3642 BBY]], removing [[Horak-mul's sarcophagus|the sarcophagus]] of [[Horak-mul]] from its grave and carrying it aboard the ''Starrunner''. The ghost of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]], however, took his revenge by driving the ship's crew insane and forcing the ''Starrunner'' to crash on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], killing Quellon and everyone on board.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quellon appears in [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Hoth
